log.note: Triage 2026-11-26: evidence checked. The report (Photonz Probe-2026-11-25-202519.ips) says 'Swift runtime failure: arithmetic overflow' at PassSampler.swift:144, which is 'let low = high - UInt64(pthread_get_stacksize_np(p))': a thread whose stack address reads lower than its stack size (likely one ending between the thread list and the read). One report, during the scrub lag task's walks (04:25Z). Kept p1 and moved up beside the perf work: the pass sampler is how the focus tasks name their stalls, and a crash ends the walk measuring them.
